integrity: Exact integer determinant, finite-field boundary-rank bounds, 234 integral torus-cycle reconstructions, automorphism orbit enumeration, and integer Smith normal forms are reproducible using packaged code. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite result for the Pappus graph and unordered two-particle configuration spaces; does not determine all H_1 torsion, higher-particle configuration homology, or arbitrary symmetric cubic graphs. Literature search is not a publication-priority certification.
title: Integral cycle-pair torus lattices in the Pappus graph's two-particle configuration space
